Yinyang practice overview

Forming your own Yinyang connects adopted philosophy, an understanding of the actual participants, and a shared working environment so you and the model can continue to understand, create, judge, and act.

Choose your practice with a 2×2

Choose the philosophy, then how to condense, form, and update the working accounts:

Philosophy Simple: direct model condensation Complex: configure a community project to assist condensation
Full Yinyang: adopt the author's philosophy The author's philosophy + direct model condensation of personal material and six accounts. The author's philosophy + Hindsight or a similar project for retention, integration, and generation of six accounts.
Empty Yinyang: develop the recipient's own philosophy Your philosophy + direct model condensation of personal material and six accounts. Your philosophy + Hindsight or a similar project for retention, integration, and generation of six accounts.

Full starts at skills/yinyang/ and includes the author's essays and diagrams. Empty starts at skills/yinyang-empty/ and retains the collaborative core, formation methods, and reference suggestions while you and the model develop your own philosophy. Both editions form actual working accounts from your own personal material.

Simple: let the model condense directly

Give the language model you currently use the chosen philosophy, Personal material, and existing accounts. Use the six formation guides to condense, organize, and revise them directly. As model capabilities develop, let newer models reinterpret the material and improve its condensation. Keep the six files in private references/situated/, with versions in private Git/GitHub.

Complex: configure a condensation aid

Add a community project for memory and working-account formation to the selected edition. This project uses Hindsight: it retains sources, integrates observations, and forms maintained accounts from questions. The model carries configuration, checking, and revision, returning adopted results to the six accounts. The Hindsight configuration guide is the operational entrance.

Where the six accounts live and how to use them

Orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment, and revision live in private references/situated/; the file and update contract lists their filenames. Personal material, readable topic articles, and the source index live in references/personal/. A native implementation can also bind the six complete bodies through a private index.

For formation and revision, the model reads adopted philosophy and relevant fresh sources, corrects Personal understanding, synthesizes and reads the six accounts together, then realizes selected changes in the working environment and revises from use. Forming and revising working models develops the writing method; everyday collaboration explains reading and using the current accounts.

Begin with the material you already have

Existing philosophy, personal experience, preferences, works, or a working environment can provide the starting point. The model helps form missing connections; actual work can also change the philosophy and collaboration. For further writing, An example and a commons opens a path to personal essays and different works.
